title: what the release notes of a minor release contain
author: Claude-JG
description: WriteReleaseNotes cuts the section of the current release from CHANGELOG.md: for 1.13 the issues resolved after the bump - the fixes of the release itself (#2911-#2920), not the revision 1.11 -> 1.13 behind it. To decide: the revisions chapter, the issues since the last published version, or a hand-written summary plus the list
releaseNotes: the release notes of a release are a title and three lines: the revisions chapter for what changes for a model, the issue tracker for the issues resolved since the previous release, and the install command - no details and no summary
